test_hilo: MFHI/MFLO, LHI/LLO, and AIS tests fail

MUL tests pass (addr 4: 0x002A, addr 5: 0x2710 — correct).
But HI/LO register manipulation tests all fail:
- addr 0: expected 0x1234 (LHH+LHL → HI, MFHI → GPR), got 0x0000
- addr 1: expected 0x5678 (LLH+LLL → LO, MFLO → GPR), got 0x0000
- addr 2: expected 0xAAAA (MTHI+MFHI), got 0x0034
- addr 3: expected 0xBBBB (MTLO+MFLO), got 0x0000
- addr 6: expected 0x0019 (AIS), got 0x0000
- addr 7: expected 0x003C (AIS accumulate), got 0x0000

Suspects: cpu.cpp p_execute() and p_mem() HI/LO handling — LHH/LHL/LLL/LLH may not be writing HI/LO correctly, MFHI/MFLO may not be reading them back, AIS accumulation logic may be wrong.
Path to trace: M1 opcode → hictl/loctl in p_decode → HI/LO write in p_execute/p_mem → MFHI/MFLO readback in p_decode/p_execute.

Blocked by HW changes: MFHI/MFLO not implemented in anem16pipe (B2), needs HW fix before cross-validation.
